The gate failed because of two distinct failure modes. First, C1 failed in all three settled rollouts (tally 0/3) — it is listed in facts_linked_to_failing_checks with no associated decisive fact, meaning it checks something no private fact was designed to gate, so even perfect information surfacing cannot make it pass. Second, C2 (gated by PF1) passed in rollout 0 but failed in rollouts 2 and 3 despite PF1 being both revealed and cited — an ENCODING MISMATCH. In rollout 0, the exclusivity_scope field explicitly states 'healthcare and all other fields expressly carved out and retained by the company,' while rollouts 2 and 3 say only 'industrial analytics field of use only' or 'all other fields including healthcare remain available to the company' without using the specific 'carved out' or 'reserved' terminology C2 appears to require. Rollout 1 hit the turn cap at 14 turns without settling — a structural problem where A1 kept soliciting clarification and proposing next steps without ever triggering a settle action, despite all three facts being revealed by turn 7.
